title: Kerala High Court Closes Plea Against Vice-Chancellor's Appointment Of University Standing Counsel After Former Counsel's Resignation
description: The Kerala High Court on Monday (July 20) closed the plea filed challenging the appointment of Advocate Girija Gopal as standing counsel for the Kerala University by its Vice-Chancellor after removing Advocate Thomas, who was appointed by the Syndicate in 2016. [2026 LiveLaw (Ker) 383] Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas noted that the plea has become infructuous since Advocate Thomas Abraham had resigned.
